Several integrations (e.g. Zoom, Office365, Google) were updated to use `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` to relax/adjust token-shape validation under this mode, but `packages/app-store/webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts` was only changed to call `refreshOAuthTokens` and was not updated to use `parseRefreshTokenResponse`. This makes it likely that when sync mode is enabled, Webex’s existing token-response validation/handling (not shown in the diff, but implied by the need for `parseRefreshTokenResponse` elsewhere) will reject a minimal sync response and fail refresh flows after expiry. The finding’s specific claim about `webexRefreshedTokenSchema` fields isn’t directly shown, but the omission of the new parsing helper in Webex is diff-grounded and can cause broken behavior in sync mode.
